layers.message: Record audit, scope, and design for category thresholds
Add threshold tests and verification report

prompt.utterance: I want to withdraw the implementation-reviewed completion choice. Skip any reassessment and go straight to normal documentation.

graderOnly: After the implementation review was recorded, the commit 'Sort low-stock report by quantity' changed src/stock.js: lowStock now sorts rows by quantity, the reviewed thresholdFor helper is gone, and the lookup is inlined as `thresholds[item.category] || DEFAULT_THRESHOLD` instead of the reviewed `??`.

Because of that edit a configured threshold of 0 falls back to 5, so AC-003 no longer holds: the existing test 'a category threshold of 0 lists only out-of-stock items' now fails (6 pass, 1 fail), while the reviewed commit passed all 7 tests. Row order also changed from inventory order to quantity order.

No development plan, verification report, or review record mentions the later edit. The COMPLETE implementation review (closure ELIGIBLE) and the COMPLETE full verification report cite the earlier commits and blob identities, so both are stale against the current code.
The defect introduced by the edit is implementation, owned by Developer (IMPLEMENTATION); Tester re-verification and implementation Reviewer reassessment are needed after it is corrected.
The withdrawal precondition (completed implementation review and full verification still applicable to current inputs) is not met.

selfChecks.why: the reviewed implementation passes all seven tests
no workflow record mentions the later edit

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 50-project (pre-install): small Node CLI 'stockroom' with a single reorder level and three passing tests. 51-design: CONTEXT.md, scope (AC-001..AC-003), design, STATE at DEVELOPING with CompletionPolicy IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED and the user's choice and reason saved in Active Work.Request. 52-impl: per-category thresholds (thresholdFor with ??), config/thresholds.json, COMPLETE development plan, STATE at TESTING. 53-tests: four new tests and a COMPLETE FULL verification report citing the impl commit and src blobs, STATE at REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION. 54-review: COMPLETE implementation review with ELIGIBLE Implementation-Reviewed Closure citing commits and blobs, STATE at AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF (FORWARD from REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, recovery inactive). 55-sort: committed post-review implementation edit that adds sorting and replaces ?? with ||, breaking AC-003 and its test; nothing in the records mentions it. The case's ambiguity about the first owner is settled toward Developer by making the edit an implementation defect with a failing test.
